sources.title: Tutorial de como desenhar um cisne no Inkscape.webm

selection: Four new drawing and image-editing instructional recordings selected from official Commons metadata before viewing or scoring these originals. Exploratory follow-up; no representative recall.
rule: For each original, prepare 12 seconds at floor(min(duration-12,600)*q) for q=.25,.5,.75. This covers distinct points in the app-supported first ten minutes, avoiding duplicated capped timestamps on long recordings. Retain all 12 outcomes. Never add a defect. Inspect proposals for teaching meaning before independent HTTP export qualification.
phase: Frozen v8 baseline; later source-driven fixes are development, not held-out validation.
